final_answer:
PROPERTY TAX DISCREPANCY REPORT - SAGUARO HOLDINGS PORTFOLIO (Ironwood A / Desert Ridge B / Arcadia C), Maricopa County, AZ
Sources: Seller's Property Disclosure Statement dated 3/5/2024 ("SDS"); Treasurer records for each APN generated 4/15/2024 ("TR"); broker workbook ("BR": Summary, Tax Detail, Rent Roll tabs). The PSA, title commitment and leases were not supplied. Figures are as of 4/15/2024 and need a bring-down.

1. BOTTOM LINE
- The SDS is materially inaccurate on taxes for all three parcels, and the broker workbook repeats the SDS figures. SDS section 11 table and BR Summary/Tax Detail say "no special assessments", "no tax liens" and "all current".
- Critical: (i) Arcadia C had a TY2020 delinquency and tax lien sale (redeemed 6/3/2022) and, per TR, a TY2023 second-half balance of $19,743.22 unpaid; (ii) Desert Ridge B carries an undisclosed CFD lien assessment of $3,812/yr plus a late first-half payment; (iii) Arcadia's building area is 16,750 SF per Assessor, not 18,200 SF; (iv) TY2023 taxes are understated for every parcel (SDS figures equal TY2022 for B and C and approximate TY2022 for A).
- Aggregate TY2023 ad valorem taxes are $178,425.41 (TR) versus $167,642 (SDS/BR), an understatement of $10,783.41; including the CFD, the burden is $182,237.41, an understatement of $14,595.41 (8.7%).
- Do not rely on SDS/BR tax data; act under section 9 before diligence expires.

2. SUMMARY TABLE (TY2023)
Item | A Ironwood | B Desert Ridge | C Arcadia
FCV: SDS/BR | $5,890,000 | $3,400,000 | $2,785,000
FCV: TR | $5,890,000 (match) | $3,640,000 (SDS low $240,000; 7.06% of SDS figure) | $2,785,000 (match)
Annual tax: SDS/BR | ~$79,500 | $51,720 | $36,422
Annual tax: TR | $84,746.10 | $54,965.58 ad valorem; $58,777.58 with CFD | $38,713.73 (see 5.3 on the computation range)
Understatement | $5,246.10 (6.2% of actual) | $3,245.58 ad valorem; $7,057.58 with CFD | $2,291.73 (6.3%)
Special assessments: SDS | None | None | None
Special assessments: TR | None | CFD No. 2008-01, $3,812/yr, lien | None
Tax liens: SDS | None | None | "None" (present) / "good standing"
Tax liens: TR | None ever | None (CFD lien) | TY2020 lien, redeemed/released 2022; no active lien
Payment: SDS | Current | Current, "timely" | "Current"
Payment: TR | Paid timely 2021-23 | TY2023 first half paid 10/14/2023 with $274.83 penalty | TY2023 second half unpaid; TY2020 second half delinquent
Building SF: SDS/BR | 38,400 | 22,100 | 18,200
Building SF: TR | 38,400 | 22,100 | 16,750 (Assessor)
Root cause: SDS tax figures are TY2022 values (B $51,720.38; C $36,422.50; A approx. $79,318.44), though labelled "tax year 2023".

3. PROPERTY A - IRONWOOD
3.1 Tax understated: $84,746.10 (primary $51,049.41 + secondary $33,696.69) versus ~$79,500; both installments were paid timely (9/28/2023; 2/26/2024). BR Tax Detail lists primary $51,049 + secondary $33,697 (= $84,746) but shows total $79,500, so BR is internally inconsistent and its NOI uses the lower figure.
3.2 Matches: FCV, no assessments/liens/delinquencies, area and lot size are consistent.
3.3 Zoning: SDS says MU-2 (Tempe); TR lists C-2 Commercial General. The Treasurer's zoning field is not authoritative; verify with Tempe Planning and obtain a zoning verification letter.
3.4 Area/rent roll: the BR suite areas sum to 39,900 SF (occupied 34,908 + vacant 4,992), exceeding 38,400 SF by 1,500 SF; BR's occupied subtotal (33,408 SF = 87%) omits Retail 104 (1,500 SF). Rent roll must be reconciled with a survey/BOMA measurement.
3.5 Acquisition year: SDS says 2017; BR says 2016 (see 7).

4. PROPERTY B - DESERT RIDGE
4.1 Undisclosed special assessment (critical): TR shows Desert Ridge CFD No. 2008-01, $3,812/yr, active since TY2009, a lien under A.R.S. Title 48 (TR cites 48-721) that "runs with the land", paid annually 2021-2023. SDS 3.2 says no special assessments "to Seller's knowledge", and SDS 11 and BR say "None". Seller paid it each year, so the knowledge qualifier is hard to credit. Obtain the CFD schedule and remaining term; BR NOI omits it.
4.2 FCV understated: SDS $3,400,000 versus TR $3,640,000 (land $1,456,000; improvements $2,184,000). BR LPV $2,720,000 versus TR $2,912,000; no TR year equals either figure. BR's secondary component ($21,128) does not equal $3.4M x 0.6103% ($20,750) and appears to be back-solved so the components total $51,720.
4.3 Tax understated: $54,965.58 (primary $32,750.66 + secondary $22,214.92) versus $51,720; with the CFD, $58,777.58.
4.4 SDS 3.2 describes secondary tax as derived from LPV; TR says primary uses LPV and secondary uses FCV. The SDS statement contradicts TR (see 8 on the TR's own method).
4.5 Payment history: first half TY2023 was paid 10/14/2023 with a $274.83 (1%) penalty, labelled "PAID - LATE". SDS says "consistent record of timely tax payments". Caveat: TR itself states installments are delinquent only after 11/1/2023 (matching A.R.S. 42-18052 as summarized in a search result; I could not open azleg.gov), so a penalty on an October 14 payment is anomalous. Obtain the Treasurer receipt before treating this as a seller misstatement; at minimum the record contradicts "timely".
4.6 Zoning: SDS I-1 (Industrial Park); TR C-2 (Intermediate Commercial) in Scottsdale. Verify with Scottsdale; confirm flex/industrial use is permitted.
4.7 Acquisition year: SDS 2016; BR 2017. Seller entity was formed 3/12/2016, so a 2016 acquisition leaves little room.
4.8 Tenant "Saguaro Robotics Research Lab" shares the Seller's name; confirm affiliation and arm's-length rent.

5. PROPERTY C - ARCADIA
5.1 Prior tax delinquency and lien (critical): TR section 4.3/6 shows the TY2020 second half ($8,214.30) went delinquent; a Certificate of Purchase (CP-2022-0017834, Copper Basin Investments LLC) arose at the February 2022 lien sale; recorded 3/15/2022 (Inst. 2022-0214508); Seller redeemed 6/3/2022 for $8,761.92; released 6/18/2022. SDS 3.3 ("good standing during its period of ownership"; Seller owned from 2019), SDS 4.3 ("no tax liens"), and BR "None" omit it. The lien is released and not an active encumbrance, but the statements are misleading by omission and show a payment-control weakness. The release instrument no. equals the redemption receipt no. (2022-0487312); check recorder records. Tenant "Copper Basin Insurance Group" (Ironwood Suite 100) shares a name with the lien purchaser; confirm whether they are affiliated .
5.2 Current delinquency (critical): TR shows the TY2023 second half ($19,356.86, due 3/1/2024) unpaid; total $19,743.22 as of 4/15/2024 including $386.36 interest, with $8.48/day continuing. The 3/5/2024 SDS said taxes were "current", yet the installment was already due and unpaid. Three caveats: (a) TR's own schedule says the installment is delinquent only after 5/1/2024, consistent with A.R.S. 42-18052, so TR's "delinquent since 3/2/2024" and interest accrual are internally inconsistent; (b) the interest does not reconcile (45 days at $8.48 = $381.60; 16% simple on $19,356.86 for 45 days = $381.83, not $386.36); (c) the SDS date precedes the delinquency date. The unpaid balance is a priority lien (A.R.S. 42-17153 per TR) and must be paid at or before closing. If unpaid after 5/1/2024 it accrues 16% simple interest (A.R.S. 42-18053) and can go to the lien sale.
5.3 Tax understated: TR total $38,713.73 versus $36,422 (+$2,291.73). TR's primary figure is itself inconsistent: line items total $23,798.83, rate x NAV gives $23,794.67, and "adjusted" is $23,708.15 (used for total and by BR). Exposure range $38,713.73 to $38,804.41; ask the Treasurer for the certified bill.
5.4 Building area (critical): TR/Assessor shows 16,750 SF, "verified during the 2017 renovation re-inspection and confirmed October 2022". SDS and BR show 18,200 SF, which overstates area by 1,450 SF (8.7% of the Assessor figure). At $3,300,000, price/SF is $197.01 on 16,750 SF versus $181.32 stated; portfolio GBA falls from 78,700 to 77,250 SF. Order an ALTA/BOMA measurement; the Assessor figure is a tax measurement and could itself be wrong, so unresolved.
5.5 Vacancy: SDS says Bay 6 (westernmost, ~2,400 SF) is vacant; TR says Bay 4 (~2,200 SF) is vacant; BR rent roll shows Bay 4 vacant (3,100 SF) and Bay 6 leased to Canyon State Tax & Accounting (3,200 SF, from 4/1/2023). Bay sizes differ across all three. SDS arithmetic is also inconsistent: 2,400 SF vacant of 18,200 is 86.8% leased, not 83%. Vacancy on the Assessor's area would be 2,200 SF (13.1%) or 3,094 SF per BR. Obtain the certified rent roll and estoppels.
5.6 Parking 58 (SDS) versus ~62 (TR); condition "Average" (Assessor) versus "good" (SDS). BR revenue ($268,800) exceeds rent-roll base rent ($221,650) by $47,150 (21%); if the gap is CAM/reimbursements it must be supported.

6. PORTFOLIO / BROKER WORKBOOK ERRORS
- Taxes: BR total $167,642 versus TR $178,425.41 ($182,237.41 with CFD). Using BR's own revenue and expense inputs, corrected NOI is: A $352,054 (cap 4.89% vs 4.96%); B $231,284 (5.32% vs 5.48%); C $149,446 (4.53% vs 4.60%); portfolio $732,785 (4.93% vs 5.03%). The roughly $14,595 annual NOI reduction is about $290,000 of value at the 5.03% cap rate. This assumes taxes are borne by the owner; many leases are NNN or modified gross, so pass-through recoveries and vacancy shares need lease review.
- Occupancy: BR Summary shows portfolio occupancy 90.5% and leased 70,614 SF, but 70,614/78,700 = 89.7% (the Rent Roll tab says 89.7% and 70,608 SF); vacant SF is 8,086 versus 8,092.
- Acquisition years for A and B are swapped between SDS and BR.
- SDS date sequence: SDS dated 3/5/2024 says it is given "pursuant to" a PSA dated 3/8/2024; signature, buyer acknowledgment and broker blocks are blank, so execution and delivery date are unproven.

7. SDS FORM AND LEGAL FRAME
- SDS cites A.R.S. 33-422, which I could not retrieve (azleg.gov was blocked); my understanding, to be verified, is that it covers an affidavit of disclosure for small parcel sales in unincorporated areas of larger counties and likely does not govern this transaction. The operative remedies are likely contractual (PSA reps, SDS certification that "any material misstatement or omission... may give rise to legal liability") plus common-law fraud and negligent misrepresentation. The PSA was not supplied, so I cannot confirm any rep survival, knowledge definition, cap, "as-is" or non-reliance language. Seller will invoke the "actual knowledge" qualifier and the verify-taxes advice, but the Seller-paid CFD and Seller-redeemed lien are within its actual knowledge.

8. RELIABILITY OF THE COUNTY RECORDS (qualifications)
- TRs are informational, not tax clearance certificates; obtain certified payoff letters.
- TR shows secondary tax on FCV and applies an 18% ratio; I could not verify against current statutes whether Arizona now bases both primary and secondary taxes on LPV or what the TY2023 ratio was. Do not rely on TR rate computations for projections; use Treasurer bills.
- Appeals: TR states appeals run 60 days from the notice of value; TY2024 notices were likely mailed around March 2024, yet SDS "current" values equal TY2023. Obtain them and calendar the deadline. Post-sale FCV may rise toward the price.

9. RECOMMENDED NEXT STEPS
1. Send a written deficiency notice to Seller and seek a corrected, signed SDS (SDS 10 allows supplements); preserve the claims.
2. Closing mechanics: require payment of the C second half and interest at or before closing; escrow holdback or credit for CFD (B) assessments (prorate), and credit for TY2023/2024 proration based on actual bills; require the title commitment to be checked for the CFD lien and the 2022 lien/release instruments.
3. Order certified Treasurer/Assessor tax statements for all three APNs, including TY2024 valuation notices and a CFD payoff or schedule.
4. Order area measurement (C, A), certified rent roll, estoppels, and zoning verification letters (A and B).
5. Re-underwrite NOI and pricing using corrected taxes and C area; seek a price adjustment.
6. Review the PSA for rep and warranty survival, indemnity, termination/extension rights and diligence-period expiry; request an extension if needed.
7. Investigate the possible affiliations noted (Copper Basin; Saguaro Robotics).

10. UNRESOLVED
- Whether the Arcadia delinquency status and interest are right (TR internal inconsistency with the 5/1/2024 delinquency date); whether the Desert Ridge penalty is valid; the true Arcadia area and vacant bay; Ironwood rent roll area; PSA terms; zoning for A and B; current status after 4/15/2024; text of A.R.S. 33-422 and the valuation/ratio statutes (not retrieved).
